Niagara Health System is a public rehabilitation center based in Welland, Ontario, that specializes in treating mental health, substance abuse, and drug and alcohol addiction. The center offers a range of therapies, including evidence-based practices, individual therapy, family therapy, group therapy, art therapy, nature therapy, nutritional counseling, and yoga and meditation. Their holistic approach to addiction treatment aims to address the physical, emotional, and spiritual aspects of recovery.

The center offers a variety of amenities, including 12-step programs, family services, and outpatient drug rehab. The 12-step program is a popular approach to addiction recovery that emphasizes the importance of spirituality, personal growth, and community support. Family services provide support to the families and loved ones of those struggling with addiction. Outpatient drug rehab allows individuals to receive treatment while still living at home, allowing for more flexibility and less disruption to daily life.

Niagara Health System’s mission is to provide quality, compassionate care to individuals struggling with addiction and mental health issues. The center employs a team of experienced professionals who are dedicated to helping patients achieve long-term recovery. Their evidence-based approach to addiction treatment has proven to be effective, with many patients reporting significant improvements in their overall health and wellbeing. If you or a loved one is struggling with addiction, Niagara Health System may be able to help.

Niagara Health System is a public rehabilitation center based in Welland, Ontario, that specializes in treating mental health, substance abuse, and drug and alcohol addiction. The center offers a range of therapies, including evidence-based practices, individual therapy, family therapy, group therapy, art therapy, nature therapy, nutritional counseling, and yoga and meditation. Their holistic approach to addiction treatment aims to address the physical, emotional, and spiritual aspects of recovery.

The center offers a variety of amenities, including 12-step programs, family services, and outpatient drug rehab. The 12-step program is a popular approach to addiction recovery that emphasizes the importance of spirituality, personal growth, and community support. Family services provide support to the families and loved ones of those struggling with addiction. Outpatient drug rehab allows individuals to receive treatment while still living at home, allowing for more flexibility and less disruption to daily life.

Niagara Health System’s mission is to provide quality, compassionate care to individuals struggling with addiction and mental health issues. The center employs a team of experienced professionals who are dedicated to helping patients achieve long-term recovery. Their evidence-based approach to addiction treatment has proven to be effective, with many patients reporting significant improvements in their overall health and wellbeing. If you or a loved one is struggling with addiction, Niagara Health System may be able to help.

Niagara Health System - Center Overview

They provide evidence-based practices, individual and family therapy, group therapy, art and nature therapy, nutritional counseling, and yoga and meditation. Their 12-step program, family services, and outpatient drug rehab are some of the amenities they offer. The center is dedicated to providing quality, compassionate care to individuals struggling with addiction and mental health issues, with the aim of achieving long-term recovery.
